svg.title: Session
svg.desc: Command: open <url>, What it does: Load a URL (a host name or file path works too) and wait for it. --new opens a new tab; --until JS waits for a condition across redirects. Alias goto.; Command: back, forward, reload, What it does: Move through the tab's history, or reload.; Command: tabs, tab select <name>, tab new, tab close, What it does: List tabs, or switch, open and close them. Pop-ups become tabs.; Command: wait, What it does: Wait for --selector, --text, --url, --js, --gone, --idle (complete document and unchanged resource-entry count for 500 ms), or --ms.; Command: eval <script>, What it does: Run JavaScript in the page as the body of an async function and print what it returns.; Command: block <types>, What it does: Stop loading images, fonts, media, stylesheets, scripts or trackers. --none clears.; Command: viewport [w h], What it does: Set the viewport. --mobile sends iPhone Safari's user agent; --scale sets the pixel ratio.; Command: handoff "<message>", What it does: Show the tab to the person for a step only they can do, then hide it again.
